objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: Retain at a node only those branches which can still be extended to an inclusion-minimal finite transversal, and contract a node whenever an earlier chosen element has become dispensable.
objection.witness: The purported proof of the blocker fact is hand-waving: the pruning/contraction rules ('retain only branches which can still be extended', 'contract a node whenever an earlier chosen element has become dispensable') are never made precise, and the König argument silently assumes the contradiction it needs. It cannot be correct since the statement is false.
